questions.question: What should I do if my baggage has been damaged during the journey?

reply.text: If your checked-in bag is damaged, go to the "Baggage Claim", "Lost Luggage" or "Lost & Found" desk in the airport's transit area before leaving, so a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) can be filed. Include the bag's brand, model, value and age. Keep the letter you receive with instructions, then repair the bag and keep the receipt, since Wizz Air will cover the repair costs shown on it. If the bag cannot be repaired, get a written confirmation from the repair shop stating the bag's type and value. Then submit a "Bag damage" claim on the Wizz Air website with a copy of the PIR and the repair receipt. If you only notice the damage after leaving the airport, report it at the airport within 7 days of arrival, and a claim must be made in writing within 7 days of discovering the damage. Wizz Air does not cover minor exterior damage such as scratches, dents or staining.

verdict.reason: The reply includes the reference steps (report at airport desk and fill in a PIR, repair and keep the receipt, submit a 'Bag damage' claim online) and adds supported details from the excerpts without contradicting them.
